quests.title: The First Royals
quests.summary: Fetch the first Jersey Royals of the year for the Central Market: seaweed, a fight in the field, and a crate.

steps.text: Ask at Le Brocq's Farm, in the country north of St Helier.
Catch a Vraicling in the shallows, beat Old Josué Le Brocq in his field, and collect the Royals from the farmhouse.
Take the Royals to the Potato Stall in the Central Market.

quests.reward: Three Jersey Royals, a Crockling and standing in the Channel Islands.

quests.title: Twelve Panels
quests.summary: Collect two witnesses' accounts of the Occupation for the Maritime Museum's tapestry gallery.

steps.text: Hear the archivist at the Jersey War Tunnels, north of St Helier.
Hear the guide at Elizabeth Castle, across the causeway.
Tell the Tapestry Guide at the Maritime Museum what you learnt.

quests.reward: The Liberation Flag (a charm) and standing in the Channel Islands.

quests.title: The Little Chapel's China
quests.summary: Find a shell and a piece of blue-and-white china to mend the wall of the Little Chapel.

steps.text: Show the beachcomber at Cobo Bay a Pinchkin you have caught, and take his shell.
Get the blue-and-white china from the baker in St Peter Port.
Bring both back to the keeper at the Little Chapel.

quests.reward: The Chapel Pebble (a charm) and standing in the Channel Islands.
